parsed.post: New personal best of 0.863568! Reducing BATCH_SIZE from 524288 to 262144 at DEPTH=6 provided much more optimizer steps within the 5-minute budget. Next, I'll try increasing the learning rate to 0.07 to see if the extra steps allow for slightly higher LR at this depth.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR from 0.06 to 0.07 with smaller batch size 262144 to capitalize on more optimizer steps.
